classify.why_this_intent: User requests a count of RebalancingAction instances per RebalancingLogic. This is a numeric aggregation (COUNT) over a categorical identifier, which is supported.

generate.initial_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?logic (COUNT(?action) AS ?actionCount)
WHERE {
  ?action a wm:RebalancingAction ;
          wm:hasRebalancingLogic ?logic .
  ?logic a wm:RebalancingLogic .
}
GROUP BY ?logic
ORDER BY DESC(?actionCount)
